mentions.name: Foreclosure Data Hub
mentions.description: This platform aggregates foreclosure auction data across the US. It pulls from 20+ sources, normalizes records from county sites and auction platforms, deduplicates properties, and enriches them with property/location data, with ongoing work on data freshness and coverage.
mentions.problem: Foreclosure information is scattered across county sites, auction platforms, and other sources with different formats and update schedules, and handling stale records when upstream sources change or republish old auction information is difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on Foreclosure Data Hub, which aggregates foreclosure auction data across the US.
mentions.author: qwikhost
